_meta.source: Pokémon Trading Card Game (Game Boy Color, 1998 JP / 2000 US) — all GBC1 opponent decks
_meta.retrieved: 2026-08-10 via Bulbapedia character pages and deck pages
_meta.scope: GBC1 only (base1 + base2 + base3 + basep in scope). GBC2 decks not included — those draw from Team Rocket and later sets.

tiers.Club Master: Eight opponents, one per club. Intermediate difficulty — designed to be beatable with the four starter decks.
tiers.Grand Master: Four opponents at the Pokémon Dome. Hard — use the GBC promo Legendary Birds and set-completion level cards.
tiers.Rival: Ronald, the repeating rival. Encounters escalate across the game from mixed-type to full Legendary build.

count_notes: All 16 decks total exactly 60 and reference only live sets (base1, base2, base3).
Ken, Amy and Mitch were re-checked against Bulbapedia raw wikitext on 12 Aug 2026; see each deck's `_source`.
Amy and Mitch are reconciliations — Bulbapedia's own lists for both total 61.
_meta.substitutions_note: Per-deck `subs` arrays replaced the old free-text `subs_applied` strings and this table on 12 Aug 2026. `kind: "placeholder"` means a card we do not have yet — swap `playing` back to `restore` when that set goes live; `restoreIsExact: false` means even `restore` approximates a GBC-exclusive card that exists in no set, so the substitute is permanent. `kind: "mapping"` is a GBC booster label for a card we already have and needs no future action.

nikki_flower_power.name: Flower Power
nikki_flower_power.strategy: Energy Trans engine via Venusaur. Runs two Grass lines (Bulbasaur, Oddish) plus Exeggutor. Exeggcute's Hypnosis costs 2 Psychic — the four Psychic Energy are specifically for it.

rick_wonders_of_science.name: Wonders of Science
rick_wonders_of_science.strategy: Poison/Grass Pokémon (Muk/Weezing) backed by two Mewtwo variants. Heavy Trainer engine with Computer Search, Pokédex and Maintenance for consistency. Grass Energy powers the Poison types (Grass-type in original TCG); Psychic for Mewtwo.

subs.note: The GBC deck plays the Wizards Promo printing. Base Set Mewtwo until basep is live.

ken_fire_charge.name: Fire Charge
ken_fire_charge.strategy: Arcanine beatdown with high-HP walls (Chansey, Tauros, Jigglypuff/Wigglytuff). Jigglypuff Promo is distinct from the Jungle printing — both are in the deck. Heavy Energy with DCE to accelerate Arcanine.

subs.note: The GBC deck plays promo and Jungle Jigglypuff as distinct cards; both collapse onto the Jungle printing until basep is live.

ken_fire_charge._source: Verified 12 Aug 2026 against the raw wikitext of Bulbapedia's "Fire Charge Deck (TCG)": 18 Pokémon / 17 Trainers / 25 Energy = 60, entry for entry. The earlier note claiming five uncaptured Trainers was wrong — the deck really does run 21 Fire Energy.

amy_rain_dancer.name: Rain Dancer
amy_rain_dancer.strategy: Blastoise Rain Dance engine: attach as many Water Energy as you want per turn. Goldeen/Seaking and Horsea/Seadra provide secondary attackers that scale with Rain Dance. Pure Water Energy — no Color required.

subs.wanted: Super Energy Retrieval (Neo Genesis 89 / Fan Book promo)
subs.note: Out of scope until neo1. Playing Energy Retrieval, the weaker in-scope equivalent, as an extra copy.

amy_rain_dancer._source: Bulbapedia's "Rain Dancer Deck (TCG)" list totals 61, not 60 (23 Pokémon / 14 Trainers / 24 Energy), counted from raw wikitext 12 Aug 2026. A judgement call was therefore unavoidable. Ours: Seaking 3->4, drop Gambler and one Potion, Super Energy Retrieval -> a third Energy Retrieval. An earlier note cited a "deck page header" giving 24/12/24 as the authority for this; that header could not be found on Bulbapedia and the reconciliation stands on its own merits, not on that citation.

isaac_zapping_selfdestruct.name: Zapping Selfdestruct
isaac_zapping_selfdestruct.strategy: Voltorb/Electrode self-destruct threats backed by Magnemite/Magneton and Electabuzz. Defender spam lets Electrode survive long enough to threaten Selfdestruct. Kangaskhan and Tauros are high-HP backup attackers.

subs.note: Electrode (Pokémon Web 26) — Japanese e-Reader exclusive; same card as Base Set Electrode

murray_strange_psyshock.name: Strange Psyshock
murray_strange_psyshock.strategy: Alakazam Damage Swap engine: move damage counters onto high-HP Chansey and Kangaskhan, then Scoop Up to heal. Mr. Mime walls certain attacks. Snorlax is a colorless stall wall. Switch and Scoop Up are both high-copy for maximum mobility.

gene_rock_crusher.name: Rock Crusher
gene_rock_crusher.strategy: Three Fighting evolution lines: Diglett/Dugtrio, Geodude/Graveler/Golem, plus standalone Onix and Rhyhorn walls. Pokémon Breeder accelerates Golem. Double Colorless supplements the Fighting costs for the higher evolutions.

mitch_first_strike.name: First-Strike
mitch_first_strike.strategy: Pure Fighting aggression. Machamp evolution line is the power core. Hitmonchan, Hitmonlee, and Mankey are aggressive basics. No Energy acceleration — just Fighting Energy and heavy support trainers.
mitch_first_strike._source: Bulbapedia's "First-Strike Deck (TCG)" list totals 61, not 60 (21 Pokémon / 15 Trainers / 25 Energy), counted from raw wikitext 12 Aug 2026. Ours drops Hitmonlee 3->2, which is the smallest change that reaches 60 and the least damaging to the deck's plan.

courtney_legendary_moltres.name: Legendary Moltres
courtney_legendary_moltres.strategy: Double Moltres (Fossil + Promo) backed by the full Ninetales and Arcanine lines. Lass disrupts the opponent's hand. Two Magmar variants provide early beatdown. Pure Fire — no Energy acceleration, just raw power.

subs.note: GBC game-completion promo, in no set we can generate. basep-21 (Black Star Promo) is the nearest corpus card and is itself an approximation.

subs.wanted: Super Energy Retrieval (Neo Genesis 89 / Fan Book promo)
subs.note: Out of scope until neo1. Playing Energy Retrieval, the weaker in-scope equivalent, as an extra copy.
Ninetales (Laboratory D12) — GBC-exclusive booster label for the Base Set card

steve_legendary_zapdos.name: Legendary Zapdos
steve_legendary_zapdos.strategy: Triple Zapdos (Fossil, Base, Promo) backed by Electabuzz beatdown and Voltorb/Electrode pressure. Eevee plus Jolteon provide an Eeveelution angle. PlusPower stacks damage for key KOs.

subs.note: As Moltres. Fossil Zapdos over Base Set Zapdos on HP.
Electrode (Pokémon Web 26) — Japanese e-Reader exclusive; same card as Base Set Electrode
Jolteon (Mystery C26) — GBC-exclusive booster label for the Jungle card

jack_legendary_articuno.name: Legendary Articuno
jack_legendary_articuno.strategy: Dual Articuno (Fossil + Promo) backed by Seel/Dewgong and Lapras walls. Chansey and Ditto are Colorless tanks. Scoop Up keeps damaged Pokémon alive. Pokémon Trader finds the right piece when needed.

subs.note: As Moltres.
Ditto (Laboratory D42) — GBC-exclusive booster label for the Fossil card

rod_legendary_dragonite.name: Legendary Dragonite
rod_legendary_dragonite.strategy: Three evolution lines: Charizard, Gyarados, and Dratini/Dragonair/Dragonite — the full Dragon family. Lapras and Kangaskhan are standalone walls. Pokémon Breeder and Trader fetch evolution pieces. Runs Water Energy because Gyarados and Lapras need it; Charizard is primarily a bench-warmer here.

subs.note: As Moltres.

subs.note: Out of scope until neo1. Playing Energy Retrieval, the weaker in-scope equivalent, as an extra copy.

ronald_im_ronald.encounter: After obtaining the second Master Medal
ronald_im_ronald.name: I'm Ronald
ronald_im_ronald.strategy: Ronald's first serious deck — three mixed types with no Energy synergy. Charmander/Arcanine line, Squirtle/Wartortle line, and Cubone/Marowak. Thin on trainers; the challenge here is the type spread requiring three Energy types.

ronald_invincible.encounter: Challenge Cup matches (between 3rd–4th and 5th–6th Master Medals)
ronald_invincible.name: Invincible Ronald
ronald_invincible.strategy: Fossil-heavy multi-type aggression. Scyther is a free-retreater and strong attacker. Muk/Weezing threaten disruption. Geodude/Graveler pressure the bench. Chansey and Kangaskhan absorb hits. Four Energy types keeps the opponent guessing.

ronald_powerful.encounter: After obtaining the fifth Master Medal
ronald_powerful.name: Powerful Ronald
ronald_powerful.strategy: Spread damage across three Energy types: Electabuzz and Hitmonchan hit hard early, Jynx and Mewtwo carry late. Doduo/Dodrio and Lickitung/Kangaskhan/Tauros are disposable high-HP bodies. PlusPower pushes KOs across thresholds.

subs.wanted: Super Energy Retrieval (Neo Genesis 89 / Fan Book promo)
subs.note: Out of scope until neo1. Playing Energy Retrieval, the weaker in-scope equivalent, as an extra copy.

ronald_legendary.encounter: After defeating all four Grand Masters at the Pokémon Dome
ronald_legendary.name: Legendary Ronald
ronald_legendary.strategy: The full Ronald showpiece. Eevee evolves into all three Eeveelutions backed by the three promo Legendary Birds. Dratini/Dragonair/Dragonite is the Dragon line. Kangaskhan pads the bench. Pokémon Trader and Breeder find the evolution chain. Scoop Up protects key Pokémon. Primarily Fire Energy for Flareon and Moltres.
